beats: Logging a meal meant scrolling past three screens before you even reached the food list.
Once the dose was calculated, you scrolled all the way back up just to find save.
A two-minute task, done several times a day, became a hunt every single time.
A JavaScript rewrite put dose and save on one bar that follows you down the page.
The whole log now fits in one scroll instead of three, with save always in view.
